title: Renormalization effects fade away during inflation
summary: The renormalization of the primordial inflationary power spectrum has long raised the possibility that ultraviolet effects could significantly alter predictions for cosmological observables. We demonstrate that inflation dynamically suppresses the entire renormalization sector: while super-Hubble perturbations freeze after horizon crossing, renormalization contributions decay rapidly during inflation.
